$schema_note: Registry of every app the factory manages. Workflows and tools read this file; humans edit it (e.g. paste the AppGallery Connect App ID after creating the app in the console).

known_gaps.ml_kit_ocr: No Huawei ML Kit dependency; OCR always falls back to manual entry and the notice text is developer-facing.
known_gaps.history_filter: Receipt History shows a false empty state until 'All Categories' is tapped.
known_gaps.backup_rules: allowBackup=true with template backup rules; receipt data can be swept into OS backups.

ads._note: Petal Ads unit IDs from the Petal Ads console (set 2026-09-06). Public identifiers, not secrets. CI exports them as PETAL_*_AD_ID for Gradle.
